chooseContainerHelp: Choose one container for pod logs, or keep all containers merged.
describeReadOnlyNote: Describe output is read-only. Edit YAML, then Apply.
pauseTailHelp: Pause live log refresh. Right-click to stop tail mode.
previousLogsHelp: Request logs from the previous container instance when Kubernetes has one.
resumeTailHelp: Resume live log refresh. Right-click to stop tail mode.
settingsFontSizeDetail: Applies to Rune's interface, YAML editors, pod shell transcripts, and command prompts.
settingsHideManagedFieldsByDefaultHelp: Hides Kubernetes managedFields in Describe and YAML inspector surfaces unless the toolbar toggle is turned off.
settingsKeyBindingsSubtitle: k9s-inspired action keys for the selected resource or release.
settingsLanguageDetail: Applies to migrated UI strings. English is used as fallback for missing translations.
settingsLogsSubtitle: Custom presets for log windows and dropdown defaults.
settingsPersistNamespaceListCacheHelp: Saves namespace names per context under Application Support/Rune/namespace-lists and restores them at startup while a fresh list loads. Does not persist logs or full resource payloads.
settingsShowDemoClusterContextHelp: Adds rune-demo to the context list and keeps the Rune menu demo action available for screenshots and first-run evaluation. It does not start a server or keep background resources alive.
settingsShowHoverTooltipsHelp: Shows short native hover explanations for less obvious labels, tabs, and controls such as Cluster Signals. Turn this off if tooltips get in the way.
settingsSimpleModeHelp: Uses a lighter interface for fast navigation: advanced optional panels are skipped, Kubernetes managedFields stay hidden in read-only YAML and Describe output, and terminal logs stay closer to a compact k9s-style workflow.
settingsSimpleModeManagedFieldsNote: Simple mode always hides managedFields in read-only YAML and Describe views.
startTailHelp: Start live log refresh and append each read to the session cache.
yamlEditsStayLocal: YAML edits stay local until Apply YAML.
